recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多個胞質豐富、淡染的組織球，胞質內吞入了完整的紅血球（橘紅色圓體）與小型有核細胞，這就是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated eosinophilic cytoplasm
Intact phagocytosed red cells (bright orange-red globules) within histiocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei (erythroid precursors or lymphocytes) inside macrophages
Histiocyte nuclei small, oval, with fine chromatin, often displaced to the periphery
Background of hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors and myeloid cells in a dilated sinusoidal stroma
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section at high power shows scattered enlarged histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm. Several histiocytes contain intact erythrocytes and small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei within their cytoplasm. The histiocytes have bland oval nuclei without atypia. The surrounding marrow contains mixed hematopoietic precursors. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, which in the clinical setting of acute EBV infection raises concern for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH); correlation with clinical and laboratory HLH criteria is required.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors in an island surround the central macrophage rather than lying within intracytoplasmic phagocytic vacuoles.
Emperipolesis occurs within large lobulated megakaryocytes with intact passenger cells, whereas here the host cells are histiocytes with small oval nuclei.

ddx.dx: Hemophagocytic histiocytic neoplasm / T-cell lymphoma-associated HLH
ddx.vs: Secondary HLH to lymphoma shows an atypical lymphoid infiltrate on immunostains (e.g. CD3, CD30, EBER), which is not evident in this field.
